points.name: Sanyinjiao
points.location: Inner leg: 3 B-cun above the inner ankle prominence, behind the tibia’s medial border.
points.research: SP6 has been studied for primary period pain. Findings are promising but do not establish a treatment schedule for you.

points.name: Guanyuan
points.location: Abdominal midline, 3 B-cun below the navel.

points.name: Zusanli
points.location: Front of leg, 3 B-cun below ST35, along the ST35 to ST41 line on tibialis anterior.

points.name: Taichong
points.location: Top of foot, between first and second metatarsals, just beyond their base junction toward the toes.

points.name: Hegu
points.location: Back of hand, thumb-side of the second metacarpal’s midpoint.

points.name: Neiguan
points.location: Palmar forearm, 2 B-cun above the wrist crease, between palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis.

points.name: Qihai
points.location: Abdominal midline, 1.5 B-cun below the navel.

points.name: Zhongji
points.location: Abdominal midline, 4 B-cun below the navel.

points.name: Guilai
points.location: 4 B-cun below the navel and 2 B-cun either side of the abdominal midline.

points.name: Xuehai
points.location: Inner-front thigh, on vastus medialis, 2 B-cun above the kneecap’s upper inner end.

points.name: Taixi
points.location: Inner ankle, in the hollow between its bony prominence and the Achilles tendon.

points.name: Shenshu
points.location: Lower back: 1.5 B-cun either side of the midline, level with L2’s spinous-process lower border.

points.name: Mingmen
points.location: Back midline, in the hollow immediately below L2’s spinous process.

atlas-period-pain.claim: Research on acupressure for primary period pain is promising but remains limited.
atlas-period-pain.evidence: A 2025 review reported pain improvement but described the evidence as low quality, with sparse adverse-event reporting. A 2024 SP6 review found heterogeneous results. A 2025 single-center trial tested combined LI4, ST36 and SP6 in 56 adolescents; it cannot isolate any one point. Older Cochrane evidence was inconclusive.

atlas-period-pain.limitations: The 2025 and 2024 review abstracts were read; full review appraisal remains pending. The 2025 adolescent trial full text was read: small single-center sample, uncertain adherence, variable pressure, and incomplete information about concurrent analgesic use. These results cannot validate the atlas, prove long-term safety, or be generalized to secondary causes of pain.
atlas-period-pain.wellnessNote: Pain that limits daily life, persists or changes deserves clinical assessment. Do not substitute this atlas for evaluation of pelvic pain.
